claims.gist: the rain falls when a chaste wife bids it, and land and town praise her: these belong to the great pattini

units.note: பெய்கெனப் பெய்தலும் recalls Kural 55's பெய்யெனப் பெய்யும் மழை, but only two words are shared, below the four-word rule, so no echo is tagged.

claims.gist: wealth confers lineage, completes learning and relieves the hunger of suffering kin, so crossing the hot desert to earn it is no hardship

units.note: The fragment does not name its speaker; it reads as someone urging a journey for wealth, so the stance is reported, not asserted.

claims.gist: a fault is a fault even in the truthful and the great, not only in ordinary people like us

claims.school_detail: the stain on the throat of the god with the forehead eye
claims.gist: the dark mark on Siva's throat is no blemish (who would say so?)

units.note: The Saiva view is implied by the rhetorical question யார் கறையன்று என்பார், not stated by a Saiva speaker.

claims.school_detail: impermanence: each state (infancy, childhood, youth) perishes in turn
claims.gist: we die day by day as each stage of life dies, so why do we not weep for ourselves?

units.note: Impermanence is also a general theme; tagged buddhist because the serial dying of states is put as the Buddhist work's teaching.

claims.gist: as fish used to an old pond long for a new flood, women's hearts turn elsewhere even when they are with Kama himself
what will turn turns, what will gain gains and what will lose loses; the wise neither grieve nor exult, and it is good to say that what is to come will come

units.note: உறுவது உறும் sounds like the Ajivika fixed order, but the verse puts it as the wise person's equanimity, so it is tagged general.

claims.school_detail: merit from earlier tapas as the seed of present fortune
claims.gist: one with no earlier tapas who toils for wealth and pleasure only suffers, like ploughing well without sowing seed
all that befalls is the fruit of deeds (வினையின் பயன்), so he neither swelled nor withered at reprieve or a death plot
the outward austerities are mere words; tapas is conduct that subdues the self

claims.school_detail: a mixed list: nakedness (Jain), ash and matted hair (Saiva), cold-water and fire austerities, living on alms
claims.gist: covering or shedding clothes, ash on the body, enduring cold, standing in fire, alms and matted hair make up tapas

units.note: The refuted list draws on several schools; jain was chosen for the nakedness, with the others in school_detail. The reading of மடிந்தொழுகல் as subdued conduct is uncertain.

claims.gist: food, wealth and learning can be guarded, but women cannot, as the learned have said

units.note: The idea is close to Kural 57 (guarding women is vain; her own restraint guards her), but the words are not shared, so no echo is tagged.

claims.gist: youth, pleasure and wealth do not last

claims.school_detail: செல்கதி: the next state of birth
claims.gist: prepare seed and water, like ploughmen, for the state you will pass to
even one who seeks wealth and enjoyment should do hard tapas full of compassion

claims.school_detail: release as a state without darkness, from which there is no return
claims.gist: by such tapas one goes to the faultless state and does not return here
